verdict.rationale: The GitHub repo states Firecrawl is open source under AGPL-3.0, an OSI-approved license, and says it is available both as open source and as a hosted service. A community comment independently confirms the AGPL code can be forked and modified. The same repo notes the cloud version at firecrawl.dev includes additional features, so not all of the product's source is open. Missing for 10: source for the cloud-only features, and documentation of exactly which parts are not in the open repo.
